title: The Scorpio Guide: Left on Read
old_caption:
Left on read and the investigation board is already up, Scorpio.
A period is not a verdict. This week, skip the decoding and say one soft true thing first.

title: The Sagittarius Guide: Bag Already Packed
old_caption:
They asked "what are we?" and you were halfway out the door.
Sag, that itch to run is often just fear. This week, answer honestly. "I don't know yet" counts.

title: The Capricorn Guide: Single at the Dinner
old_caption:
"So, seeing anyone?" Capricorn, you're allowed to just smile and say not yet.
This week, log off at seven once and text someone you actually like.

title: The Aquarius Guide: Gone Quiet
old_caption:
Mid-feeling, headphones on, gone. Aquarius, we see you.
Needing space is fine. This week, say "I need a minute," take it, and then come back. That's the promise.

title: The Pisces Guide: Crying at the Playlist
old_caption:
Crying about the ex again? Missing them means it mattered, not that you should go back.
Pisces, let it hurt, then text a friend with snacks. Not the ex.

title: How Taurus loves in winter
old_caption: Taurus, your love looks like blankets, soup and slow Sundays. The coziest thing you can do this winter is scoot over and make room for them on the couch.

title: How Gemini loves in winter
old_caption: Snowed in, Gemini? Twenty texts can't do what one call does. Send the message, then dial. Let them hear you laugh.

title: How Cancer loves in winter
old_caption: Cancer, you're the one with the cocoa, the extra blanket and the hand-knit socks. This winter, let someone bring the mug to you. Being cared for counts too.

title: How Leo loves in winter
old_caption: Leo, you warm up every cold room you walk into. The loving move is saving the best seat by the fire for them. Shine beside them, not over them.

title: How Virgo loves in winter
old_caption: Virgo, the scarf, the gloves and the backup scarf are all love, and they notice. Add one more thing to the list this winter: tell them how you feel, out loud.
